name: Nanase Touya
source:
A 2nd year student belonging to "The Forgotten Stones" class.

The leader of "The Resistance", an organisation which goes against the academy's system. A frank and cheerful person, but a little short-tempered. Possessing a firm sense of justice, he can't overlook injustices or those who are troubled. He has his doubts about the school's deeply-rooted caste system and the reason for "The Ignored Stones'" existence. Wearing "The Roses in Full Bloom's" uniform blazer without permission, he goes against the school's rules head-on with a fearless attitude.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2014/04/28/zettai-kaikyuu-gakuen-eden-with-roses-and-phantasm/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
